scenes.title: The Culprit Unmasked
scenes.summary: Nathan confirms that the leaked contract was photocopied at ASK. Andrea and Gabriel confront Mathias, who admits his maneuvers to save ASK. Hicham abruptly announces he is selling his shares to Mathias.

scenes.title: Panic and Betrayals
scenes.summary: While Mathias organizes the 30th anniversary party, Noémie urges him to look to the future. Gabriel and Andrea consider resigning in protest, while Camille Valentini vents her frustration over agency intrigues.

scenes.title: The Other Isabelle
scenes.summary: Andrea, Gabriel, and Arlette search for a way to break Mathias's leverage with the Americans. Andrea hatches a wild scheme: finding a namesake to claim Isabelle Huppert's ghost shot the disputed scene.

scenes.title: Temporary Truce
scenes.summary: Mathias tries to appease Andrea and Gabriel by offering higher shares and salaries under his leadership. Andrea agrees to consider it to avoid an open confrontation at the anniversary party.

scenes.title: Traitor's Daughter
scenes.summary: At ASK, Camille, Noémie, and Hervé clash over Mathias's betrayal and agency loyalties while cleaning up the office for the anniversary party.

scenes.title: The Namesake
scenes.summary: Andréa tracks down a nurse whose legal name is Isabelle Huppert at a Paris hospital, trying to convince her to stand in for a movie shoot.

scenes.title: Andréa's Breakdown
scenes.summary: When the nurse refuses the offer, Andréa breaks down from postpartum exhaustion and agency stress, prompting the sympathetic nurse to offer comfort.

scenes.title: The Geisha and the Corpse
scenes.summary: On set, the director complains that the nurse looks like a geisha instead of a ghost, while Isabelle corrects him on accurate corpse lividity.

scenes.title: Arlette's Negotiation
scenes.summary: Arlette negotiates with producer Laurence to endorse the homonym contract scheme, offering Cécile de France and Josiane Balasko to seal the agreement.

scenes.title: Sophia's Boxes
scenes.summary: Gabriel visits Sophia as she packs boxes to move back in with her parents, and the two trade bitter truths about their struggling careers and personal losses.

scenes.title: Filming the Ghost
scenes.summary: Camille oversees an amateur video shoot with lookalike Isabelle playing a queen's ghost, navigating the director's artsy demands and comic filming mishaps.

scenes.title: The Ghost's Silence
scenes.summary: Freezing in the cold, lookalike Isabelle struggles with her dialogue until Camille suggests that a ghost is far more menacing without speaking any lines.

scenes.title: The Double on Set
scenes.summary: On the movie set, Gabriel and the director film the ghost scene using Isabelle Huppert's nurse double. Gabriel pushes the director to accept the performance so Isabelle can attend the ASK anniversary party undetected.

scenes.title: The Realm of the Dead
scenes.summary: On the dimly lit film set, the stand-in delivers the ghost's dramatic farewell line. The perfectionist director complains about the loud rustle of leaves, but Gabriel insists the take is poetic and urges him to wrap up.

scenes.title: Renard's Secret Mission
scenes.summary: At the entrance of the ASK building, Mathias approaches security guard Renard with a confidential task. He instructs Renard to notify him immediately when two American executives arrive at 10 PM.

scenes.title: Thirty Years of ASK
scenes.summary: Isabelle Huppert arrives at the agency party after escaping the set. Mathias welcomes his star client, celebrating thirty years of ASK and toasting to the agency's united family.

scenes.title: Mutual Confessions
scenes.summary: In a quiet corridor at the anniversary party, Catherine and Mathias have an honest discussion about their failing marriage, discovering that both of them have fallen in love with someone else.

scenes.title: Hervé's Friend
scenes.summary: At the anniversary party, Camille confronts Hervé about his eccentric elderly friend Corinne talking to agency stars, while the agents scramble frantically when star client Isabelle Huppert goes missing.

scenes.title: A Secret Warning
scenes.summary: In the noisy party corridor, Mathias is pulled aside with alarming news that star client Guillaume Canet is planning to leave the agency, prompting an urgent private conversation away from the crowd.

scenes.title: Isabelle's Double
scenes.summary: At the ASK anniversary party, Corinne arrives and innocently reveals to Noémie that she served as Isabelle Huppert's secret double, triggering panic over what the producers might discover.

scenes.title: The Artistic Double
scenes.summary: Confronted by suspicious American producers over Isabelle Huppert's double shooting, Andréa and Gabriel explain that director Cédric Kahn hired an artistic double to create a poetic ghost.

scenes.title: A Provincial Nurse
scenes.summary: In the screening room, Corinne moves the producers to tears with the true story of a dying hospital patient, Claude Lelouch offers her a role, and Andréa proudly thanks her.

scenes.title: Before the Speech
scenes.summary: Backstage at the ASK thirtieth anniversary gala, Camille alerts Hicham that the packed room is waiting for him. Noticing his nervous tension, she brings him a glass of water before he steps up to the microphone.

scenes.title: The Thirty-Year Speech
scenes.summary: On the gala stage, Hicham delivers a moving speech celebrating thirty years of ASK and honoring Arlette. Off-stage, Andréa confronts Mathias, revealing that the team has united and defeated his takeover plan.

scenes.title: An Agent Elsewhere
scenes.summary: In the hallway outside the gala, Camille catches up with Mathias as he prepares to leave ASK. Though she chooses to remain at the agency, Mathias warmly encourages her before Noémie runs out to join him.

scenes.title: The Truth About Philippe
scenes.summary: In the agency lounge, Camille reveals the staggering truth to Hervé that their secret client Philippe was Mathias Barneville all along. Hervé reels in shock as they process Mathias's deception.

scenes.title: Hicham's Offer
scenes.summary: Late at night at ASK, Andréa and Hicham reflect on Mathias's departure. Announcing that he is relocating to London to be near his son, Hicham offers Andréa the role of Director General to run the agency.

scenes.title: The César Nominations
scenes.summary: In the early hours at ASK, the phone rings with the official César nominations: Sophia Leprince is nominated as Best Newcomer. As the agency celebrates her triumph, Andréa embraces her new role as director, ushering in a fresh beginning for ASK.
